text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I must thank you for inviting
me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I feel truly honored to be having tea
with you all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't have to act all formal just
because
you're in the presence of a
first-rate athlete such
as myself, Satono!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Please speak freely and eat
as many
sweets as you like!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Here, have a seat. Let's enjoy this day
together,
Satono.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Would you care for some jam cookies
with your
tea? They're a delicacy, kindly
sent by my
grandmother.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! So the recent charity cup was
also hosted
by your family, Satono?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I helped my parents with the event,
though I
didn't do much.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wow... I'd heard stories, but your family
certainly
is enthusiastic about this stuff.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Your parents' names are often
mentioned in my own social circles.
They're said to be quite
wealthy and
philanthropic.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Goodness. I'm delighted that you know
of
them! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I think it's just so lovely of you to help
out your
parents!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Ever since I was a child, I've been
watching
my parents helping others...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So naturally, I found myself hoping to
follow in
their footsteps!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I know just what you mean! "A princess
must be of
service!" Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A house of distinguished nobility and
renowned
philanthropists...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...that went on to produce an
Umamusume who is
now enrolled at
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A great many must be watching you with
keen
interest.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...McQueen?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I spot Satono Diamond in the middle of
a press
interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your enlightening
comments,
Satono Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Actually, there have been a great
number of
voices eagerly awaiting the
release of your
exclusive interview.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Really now? How wonderful. ♪

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I can see that the public have lofty

expectations for you indeed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'd better ensure that I do the best job I
can as
well! Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Lofty expectations, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That was a splendid interview, Satono.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Ah, McQueen! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As the reporter mentioned, your article
is likely to
be read by a lot of people.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That certainly would be lovely!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...You don't happen to feel under
pressure, do
you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I appreciate your concern, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: But I'm quite all right!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My family and all of their acquaintances
have
been kind enough to celebrate my
birth and wish
for my success.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Their support has always been a source
of
comfort and encouragement to
me—never a
burden!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it appears I was worried for
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So it's not pressure you feel, but
inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fulfilling one's born duties is no small
feat, you
know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I know! But I embrace the challenge,
McQueen!
